author: eyigitba
body:
#### PR description:

This is a follow up PR to https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/51330. The idea is to add another option to modify FEVTDEBUGHLTEventContent on top of MINIAODSIMEventContent. The reason behind this is to have the option to produce GEN-SIM-DIGI-RAW tier MC samples with the reduced event format in the Fall26 campaign if needed.

For now, there is no urgency for the current round of MC samples. This is just in case we request L1 Scouting samples in the future. 

In addition, for now, I kept the same process modifier but simply added a line to modify either of the event contents with the same modifier. If people think it's safer to duplicate the modifier and create separate modifiers for FEVTDEBUGHLTEventContent and MINIAODSIMEventContent I can modify this PR.

#### PR validation:

Validated by running DIGI-RAW step with Fall26 cmsDriver commands with the procModifier added. It produces the reduced format as planned.

#### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for:

Will be backported to 20_0_X once approved for master.
title: [L1T] Adding an option to modify FEVTDEBUGHLTEventContent for L1 Scouting
